anya: Morning team — huge news: we cleared the Q1 ARR goal and the launch is live 🎉. Bagels + coffee in the kitchen in 10 mins. Mini gong at 11:00 for anyone remote hit the virtual bell! :tada:

mike: OMG yes. I will bring the actual tiny gong from my desk. :drum:

kevin: remote but I will ring an emoji bell from here 🔔. congrats all!!

lina: I’ll bring oat milk and croissants. can someone snag a plant watering duty slip? 🌱

sam: photo takeover incoming. will spam the #random feed with confetti pics. :camera_with_flash:

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: release v1.8.0 — traffic switched, no errors. :white_check_mark:

anya: love the energy. quick ask — if you took the gong, please return it by EOD or next team meeting. low-key competition for best celebratory noise maker. :grin:

mike: noted. leaving a sticker on it so we can identify. @lina you get first dibs on plant watering this week (kidding... sort of) :seedling:

kevin: can we get a virtual confetti GIF in the thread? i’ll start a poll: real confetti or no-cleanup confetti? :balloon:

lina: poll answer: both. physical confetti outside only, inside is for photos. :sweat_smile:

sam: also — big shoutout to infra team for the late-night slog. anyone who wants to send kudos, add a :heart: react to this thread and i'll compile a little slack slack-reel for them.

anya: yes please. running this as a short weekly tradition now — small wins, quick celebration. thanks team, unbelievably proud. :sparkles:
